name: from_raw_in
declaration: unsafe fn from_raw_in (ptr : * const T , alloc : A) -> Self
rules: The pointer passed to Weak::from_raw_in must originate from a previous call to Weak::into_raw paired with this call.
The pointer must still own its potential weak reference; pointers created by Weak::new do not own a weak reference.
The pointer must point to a block of memory allocated by the supplied alloc.
